channel.title: 0xmrerror — writeups
channel.description: Reverse engineer, malware analyst and SOC automation engineer. ICT student at ENIT, top 1% on TryHackMe, 77th at HTB University CTF 2025. Open to internships.

item.title: Easy as GDB — Scripted Character-by-Character Brute Force
item.description: The flag is validated one character at a time, so automate it: script GDB to brute-force the key space inside a single session.

item.title: Keygenme — MD5 Hex Spliced Into a License Key
item.description: The binary assembles the full 36-character key on the stack out of two MD5 digests — so the lazy solve is to break in and read it out.

item.title: Mr Robot CTF — WordPress to Root
item.description: A WordPress blog with a leaked wordlist, weak credentials and a hidden base64 login — a four-stage chain from recon to root.

item.title: WWBuddy — SQLi to Env-Var Privesc
item.description: A half-built 'make friends' site with SQLi in the signup flow, and an environment-variable leak that turns a web foothold into sudo.

item.title: Broker — MQTT Eavesdrop to Webshell
item.description: An exposed ActiveMQ/MQTT broker lets anyone subscribe to every sensor on the network — then a webshell upgrade path to root.

item.title: Watcher — LFI to Root in 7 Flags
item.description: A boot2root with a long linear chain: LFI becomes a webshell, a writable service binary becomes root. Seven flags along the way.

item.title: Fortress — SHA-1 Collision to Root
item.description: Story-driven decompilation: Python bytecode leaks credentials, a telnet service hands over a client binary, a hash chain ends at root.

item.title: Umbrella — Registry Loot to SUID Bash
item.description: An open Docker registry leaks database secrets, MySQL credentials unlock the source, and a writable PATH entry hands over SUID bash.

item.title: Super Secret Tip — Jinja SSTI to curl -K Root
item.description: Jinja SSTI in a password-protected Werkzeug debugger chains into a planted curl config file — and curl -K becomes root.

item.title: Smol — WP Plugin SSRF to sudo Bash
item.description: A legacy WordPress plugin with a pile of CVEs, a poisoned Hello-Dolly backdoor, and an SSRF that reaches straight into the sudoers file.

item.title: WinAntiDbg0x200 — Three Anti-Debug Checks
item.description: Three stacked anti-debug checks — PEB flag, timing and NtQueryInformationProcess — reversed live in GDB to recover the flag.

item.title: WinAntiDbg0x300 — UPX, a Watchdog, and an Infinite Loop
item.description: UPX unpacking, a child-process watchdog and an infinite loop that never actually exits. A full GDB walkthrough.

item.title: Binary Instrumentation 2 — Intercepting File Writes With Frida
item.description: picoCTF 2025 · 300 pts. Hook the file-write API with Frida and rewrite the payload before it ever touches disk.

item.title: JITFP — Reading a Flag That Only Exists in Live Memory
item.description: A checker whose function-pointer table is empty on disk and filled at runtime by a ptrace service — read RDX at the call and never touch the table.
